(Please be sure to nominate R.E.P.O. for pretty much any category in the steam awards. It was robbed of being even mentioned in the gaming awards.)

R.E.P.O. is the type of game that once you play it, you'll realize why everyone loves it.

On the outside it seems very simple... A fun little game with freaking adorable robots with Lethal Company like gameplay. But try playing it Solo just one round and you'll remember that, despite its sweet charms, it still very much a scary game.

The spooky atmosphere, crazy items with insane reactions, and wide range of monsters make for a variety of levels, instead of the same thing on repeat.

If you do have friends to play with, I recommend doing so. If not, I recommend joining a stranger's game via the in-game options to do so. Because while R.E.P.O. is incredibly enjoyable solo, its multiplayer is where it really shines.

Like many other Lethal Company-likes I grow bored of this gameplay loop particularly fast. Fortunately for R.E.P.O. offers a much more efficient gameplay loop, has some baked in comedic features, and utilizes the proximity chat feature enough to say it's being used.

If it were between this and Lethal Company, I'd take R.E.P.O. every time.

I've been following this studio since they were ThunderHumor, and seeing them release a game title that has gathered so much attention is immensely pleasing- the completely deserve it.

Having been there during their YT animation days, it's lovely seeing their artstyle persist in the way everything moves- exaggerated movement that springs back and wobbles, which is perfect for a goofy physics-based game.

At the moment there are only 3 maps, but they vary wildly in layout, becoming more labyrinthine as you progress- this being said, I am very eager to see new additions to both map and item variety.

There are definetly a few balancing issues here and there, but some of it is a matter of the game being a bit hard just because that's what makes it fun- it's unforgiving, which produces that desperate drive to continue, while also producing some wonderfully funny moments.

Overall this is a great game to pick up if you're looking for something new to play with friends.

I play solo because all my gamer friends disappeared or never existed so I jumped into Repo through quick play fully expecting chaos and yep, chaos happened but the fun kind!

Even without a squad, the game is super enjoyable. You can sneak, run, mess up horribly, and somehow still feel like a legend. The missions keep things moving, the tension builds in a fun way, and even when things go wrong (and they will), it’s hilarious, not frustrating.

Random teammates were mostly chill, and honestly? Half the fun is seeing how well you can all coordinate without saying a single word. Spoiler: not well, but it's still a good time.

If you’re a solo player wondering if you’ll have fun — yes. Panic, steal stuff, run like heck. 10/10 would scream silently again.

R.E.P.O. is an absolute hit.

This is a co-op PC Horror (but funny with friends) game that relies on physics, proximity voice chat, gradual ability upgrades, and weapons/traps of your choosing. The monsters can hear and/or see you. Different creatures have various levels of health as well as ways they may detect you. With other players you generally have better odds at surviving. The goal is to fill a cart with an assortment of valuable items till you reach a specified amount and bring to a designated location. As you progress it becomes more challenging from monsters, to the monetary goal.

An aspect I really appreciate is that even as you may die multiple times (with others still alive), you're not useless to the game. You can continue to chat with them for short periods- shouting helpful notes or sabotaging them by accident {usually).

The public lobbies can be fun if you don't have too many friends with this game, buttt... they should definitely get it by now!

I hope you enjoy it as much as I have! 11/10 game!
